name: Connor Clark
title: Assistant Project Manager
bio:
Connor Clark originally joined The Ritchie Group in 2020 and returned in 2022 as an Assistant Project Manager and Financial Analyst. Prior to this, he has had exposure to various classes of real estate transactions, including industrial development, multifamily development, multifamily acquisitions, and portfolio management. Most recently, Connor spent time with USAA Real Estate on their Industrial Development and Portfolio Management teams. His primary responsibilities at the Ritchie Group include project management for multifamily properties and financial analysis of deal flow within the company.

Connor received a Bachelor of Science degree in Finance with an emphasis in real estate from the Marriott School of Business at Brigham Young University. Outside of work, Connor enjoys backpacking, skiing, mountain biking, reading, playing sports, and picking up new hobbies.
